answer_1.quote: We use this framework to develop QAGS (Question Answering and Generation for Summarization), a metric for evaluating the factual consistency of abstractive document summaries ...

answer_2.quote: We compare against a number of automatic evaluation metrics: ROUGE, METEOR, BLEU, and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: We collect human judgments on Amazon Mechanical Turk via ParlAI. We present summaries one sentence at a time, along with the entire article. For each summary sentence, the annotator makes a binary decision as to whether the sentence is factually consistent with the article.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators decide per summary sentence whether it is factually consistent with the source article (binary consistency judgment).
